messages:
tom-billing: Heads-up: customer ParkGrid (PG-59) invoice INV-2026-744 failed autopay. Processor declined with code 'card_expired' and token status expired.
ivy-support: Opening ticket for customer. They say they updated card in portal yesterday but still seeing decline.
ravi-payments: Our logs show two retry attempts after expiry notice; both declined. New card token created at 1845001280 but not yet authorized. Token last4=1111.
billing-bot: Auto-retry disabled for expired tokens. Manual reattempt requires explicit capture by payments team.
tom-billing: Invoice amount = $2,980. Customer requests 7-day grace and asks if we can waive late fee. Need approval from sales/finance/legal for fee waiver > $50.
sophie-sales: Customer is active ARR account and likely to renew. Approve waiving the standard $75 late fee as a one-time courtesy if they complete payment in 7 days. I'll get confirmation from customer.
harry-legal: No contract issues with waiving one-time fee; note addendum in contract notes that late fee waived contingent on payment within 7 days. I'll prepare short email language.
ravi-payments: Operational plan: once customer updates card, we'll run an authorization $1 test then capture full amount. If they prefer wire, we'll accept and mark awaiting_wire. Do not mark PAID until funds settle.
tom-billing: Also scanning for potential double-charges since they updated card twice. Ensure we don't create duplicate invoices if both methods succeed.
ivy-support: Draft message to customer: "We saw your card expired and the token was declined. We can hold a 7-day grace and waive the $75 late fee if you update payment method within that time or initiate a wire. Please confirm which you prefer and if you'd like wire instructions."
sophie-sales: Customer replied: "We updated the card this morning and will use the card in the portal. Please retry."
ravi-payments: Authorizing $1 test at 1845001325. Authorization succeeded. Proceeding to capture full amount at 1845001330.
ledger-bot: Capture posted reference PAY-2026-940. Preliminary status: pending_settlement. Temporary fee waiver note added.
tom-billing: Marking invoice PAID once settlement clears. Removing auto-collection triggers.
harry-legal: Adding signed note to contract: waiver conditional on payment settlement within 7 days.
ivy-support: Customer confirmed no service interruption and thanks team.
ledger-bot: Invoice INV-2026-744 set to pending_settlement. Will close when funds clear.
Tom-billing: Closing thread; follow-up: FIN-3705 to audit token expiry notifications and ensure customers get clearer in-app prompts to update cards before expiry.
